{{Navbox/Stats}}
{{stat|Damage}} is the amount of {{stat|Health}} or {{stat|Shield}} an attack will remove when it lands.

For enemies, the shown damage is the damage of their basic attack. 

Damage can only ever remove 1 {{stat|Holy Shield}} or {{stat|Corpse Health}} at a time.

== Damage Types ==
; {{icon|Physical damage}}
* Physical damage can be either melee or ranged.
** Abilities default to the {{ActiveType|Melee}} and {{ActiveType|Ranged}} icon respectively, depending on which they are.
** This has no bearing on the damage itself, but is relevant for some effects.
* The damage is increased by {{st|Bruise}}.
* The damage can randomly [[crit]].
* Physical damage crits are affected by the units crit damage multiplier.
* It is guaranteed to crit against units with {{st|Marked}} and will ignore their {{stat|Shield}}.
* The damage can [[backstab]].
* {{icon|Champions|link=y}} deal +1 physical damage.


; {{icon|Magic damage}}
* Abilities that deal Magic damage default to the {{activetype|Magic}} icon.
* The damage is increased by {{st|Magic Damage Up}} and innate Magic damage increases.
* It is guaranteed to crit against units with {{st|Magic Weakness}}.


; {{icon|Physical Magic damage}}
* Has both the properties of {{icon|physical}} and {{icon|Magic}} damage.


; {{icon|Knockback damage}}
* Knockback damage is a result of a unit being knocked back and colliding with something, or being thrown.
* The damage is increased by {{st|Bruise}}, {{st|Bonus Knockback Damage}} and innate knockback damage increases.

=== Misc damage types ===
; Trample damage
* Shown on the unit's movement action if their movement action doesn't innately deal damage.
* Is increased by {{st|Bruise}}.


; <code>Status Spell</code>
* Used inconsistently for self-harm, buff and healing items.
* The damage shows with the default {{icon|physical}} icon, but will crit with {{st|Magic Weakness}}.
** Does not have any other physical or magical interactions.


* Damage from {{st|Thorns}}, cannot be dodged, can be blocked.
* Damage from {{st|Poison}}, {{st|Burn}}, {{st|Bleed}}, {{st|Leeches}}, cannot be dodged or blocked.
* Damage from {{st|Exhaustion}} cannot be dodged, blocked or reduced by any effects.
* Damage from tiles does not deal damage to {{stat|Corpse Health}}.

== Damage Reduction ==
Damage reducion happens before crit calculations.

* {{st|Brace}} reduces damage by 1 per stack.
* {{st|Petrify}} reduces all damage to 1.

== Healing ==
{{icon|Healing}} is largely identical to damage, increasing health instead of decreasing it.

Healing effects also have a damage type which keeps some of the same interactions as damage.

Wether healing is physical, magic or neither is not shown.<br>
The {{icon|Physical Heal|nolabel=y}}{{icon|Magic Heal|nolabel=y}} icons only show that the abilitiy will heal allies and which damage it will deal to other units.

; Physical Healing
* Can randomly crit and crits on units with {{st|Marked}}.
* Cannot backstab and will not be increased by {{st|Bruise}}.
<!--Should we list examples?-->

; Magic Healing
* The damage is increased by {{st|Magic Damage Up}} and innate Magic damage increases.
* It is guaranteed to crit against units with {{st|Magic Weakness}}.

== Notes ==
* Damage on enemies tooltip does not change to reflect if their basic attack is magic damage or healing.
* Only physical damage being increased by crit damage increases may be a bug.
* All player inflicted damage types can crit with specific passives or item effects.
